Use whenever the user mentions tuning IREE dispatch tile sizes, agentic tile search, or wants to replace GA-based tile-size search with LLM-driven search. Author: Nick Hung <nick@andestech.com>

    Gate Andes-CSR transport on per-engine capability
    
    Restoring or draining an Andes custom CSR the target core does not
    implement can hang the DM handshake (observed on ax45mpv_premium: ucode
    without DSP, mecc_code without ECC). Transport only the CSRs the core's
    config.inc actually configures in.
    
    - andes_caps.hpp: pure CSR-address -> feature-gate map + AndesCaps mask
      (the X-macro still owns the CSR list; only the gate is added).
    - andes_caps_config.hpp: build AndesCaps from the compiled-in _NDS_*
      config macros (sim-binary only; unit tests stay Verilator-free).
    - ResumeDriver / StateDrain take an AndesCaps (default all() = prior
      behavior) and skip ungated CSRs; HandoffController + simulator inject
      the real caps.
    - --describe emits andes_csrs so the andesim driver can verify-exclude
      CSRs the engine lacks.
    
    Behavioral change. Units: andes_caps{,_config}.test.cpp; resume/drain
    tests gain the gated-skip cases.

35	  // fields from the snapshot into the freshly drained GPRs+PC, avoiding
